# Good Light Group

> Good Light Group provides BioCentric Lighting solutions and health-tech products designed to optimize circadian rhythms, sleep quality, and workplace wellness through scientifically-backed light therapy.

Good Light Group specializes in innovative lighting solutions that align with human circadian biology. The company offers a curated portfolio of products including Somnoblue, Propeaq, Lumie, and Sparckel, alongside implementation guidance through their Good Light Experience program and real-world case studies like the CosmoDent dental clinic project.

## Lighting Solutions & Products

- [Solutions](https://www.goodlightgroup.org/solutions): Product solutions directory featuring Somnoblue, Propeaq, Lumie, Sparckel and other BioCentric Lighting products for health and wellness

## Implementation & Guidance

- [Good Light Experience](https://www.goodlightgroup.org/good-light-experience): 30-day light exposure challenge guide for improving sleep quality and productivity through structured light therapy

## Case Studies & Projects

- [CosmoDent Dental Clinic Project](https://www.goodlightgroup.org/projects-cosmodent): Real-world implementation of BioCentric Lighting in a dental clinic environment showcasing health benefits and patient outcomes
